items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: I got a, I got a card from him Christmas. Every year, he is, I don't know if I, how you do it, but he send a Christmas card to me and tell me that, Mr. and Mrs. Foster.

ctx.x: John's dead. John's dead. And Ashiel's dead. But, of course, Ashiel was a clarinet player. He was tough.
Did you ever work with him, too?
